infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: TrygKreds shows your last known location to the groups you choose to share with.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: TrygKreds keeps your last known location up to date for the groups you share with, so they can see roughly where you are. Only your latest position is stored, never a history, and it is deleted when you stop sharing.
